1: AGENTS.md — rules for AI coding agents in this repository
2: 
3: BNJI.NET is a personal digital hub: Astro 7, static output, Cloudflare Workers static assets, hand-written CSS, and a small set of TypeScript client modules. There is no UI framework (no React/Vue/Svelte islands). Everything a visitor sees is HTML + CSS; JavaScript only enhances.
4: 
5: Read this file first. The rules below exist to keep the build fast, the bundle tiny, the design coherent and the deployment boring.
6: 
7: ## 1. Hard rules (do not violate)
8: 
9: - **No new dependencies.** package.json and package-lock.json are frozen. Never add npm packages, never run a lockfile-writing install in CI-like environments (`npm install --no-package-lock` if resolution drifts).
10: - **Do not modify deployment infrastructure:** wrangler.json, the Worker entry, .gitignore exclusions (.astro/, .wrangler/, dist/, node\_modules/), or public/fonts/.
11: - **Canonical origin lives in one place:** src/data/site.ts (SITE.url). astro.config.mjs imports it for `site:`. Components must use absoluteUrl()/SITE.url — never Astro.url, never location, never a hardcoded domain other than in site.ts.
12: - **No secrets in source.** No API keys, tokens or private endpoints in code, docs or commit messages. Secrets are environment-only and read exclusively through src/server/env.ts (astro:env/server getSecret + worker bindings); the schema lives in astro.config.mjs. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
13: - **No secrets in agent context — local or hosted, no exceptions.** This rule is about what an agent ever *sees*, not just what it writes:
14:   - Never include .dev.vars, .env, or any file holding a live credential value in a prompt, a pasted file, or repo context handed to any coding agent. If an agent needs to know what a config surface looks like, give it docs/CONFIGURATION.md or a placeholder file with variable names and dummy-shaped values only (e.g. `SESSION_SECRET=changeme`, `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=https://discord.com/api/webhooks/PLACEHOLDER`) — never the real .dev.vars.
15:   - Agents write code against the binding name (`env.SESSION_SECRET`, `env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL`) and never invent, hardcode, or request a real value in conversation. A value the agent needs to run something locally should be a throwaway dummy the developer sets in .dev.vars, not a credential that ever leaves the machine.
16:   - This applies with extra weight to hosted free-tier models: their terms may log prompts or use them for training, so nothing secret-shaped gets pasted to them under any circumstance, redacted or not — leave the whole file out rather than redacting it.
17: - **No personal biography.** Identity copy is neutral placeholder text (lorem ipsum). Never reintroduce real names, locations, schools, hardware or life details anywhere — components, data, docs, blog or assets.
18: - **Configuration lives in src/config/** (music, dm integration, board policy, access rules, theme, intro) and is documented in docs/CONFIGURATION.md. Components read config; they never hard-code service URLs, limits or provider behaviour. docs/CONFIGURATION.md should list every variable name and its expected shape alongside a placeholder value — that's the file an agent gets handed instead of a real .dev.vars.
19: - **Keep the blog workflow dumb-simple:** a post is one Markdown file in src/content/blog/ (MDX and its workflow were removed). Never introduce a CMS, a build step for content, or a second content directory.
20: 
21: ## 2. Architecture map
22: 
23: 
24: | Path                | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                             |
25: | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
26: | src/config/\*.ts    | All owner-facing configuration: music source, DM provider, board policy, ACCESS\_RULES, theme + intro settings. Public values only.                                                                 |
27: | src/server/\*.ts    | Server-only modules: board stores (memory/kv/rest), rate limiter, access primitives, env access. Never imported by client code.                                                                     |
28: | src/middleware.ts   | Route-guard enforcement for ACCESS\_RULES (SSR routes only; honest about static limits).                                                                                                            |
29: | src/pages/api/\*    | API boundaries: /api/board, /api/dm. prerender = false; validation, sanitization, rate limits live here.                                                                                            |
30: | src/data/\*.ts      | All site content as typed data (site, navigation, projects, interests, ai-stack, network, lab, blog helpers). Components and pages read from here.                                                  |
31: | src/components/     | Astro components. Primitives: GlassPanel, GlassButton, SectionHeading, PageHeader, BrandMark, Icon. Sections: Hero, AboutPreview, ProjectsPreview, …                                                |
32: | src/components/lab/ | Runnable experiments for /lab/. Each owns its DOM subtree + rAF loop, pauses via IntersectionObserver, has a destroy() path.                                                                        |
33: | src/layouts/        | Layout.astro (shell: head, starfield, header, footer, boot script), BlogPost.astro (article chrome + pager).                                                                                        |
34: | src/pages/          | Routes. rss.xml.ts is the typed RSS endpoint.                                                                                                                                                       |
35: | src/scripts/        | Client runtime. starfield.ts (canvas engine), interactions.ts (cursor glow, glass tracking, magnetic buttons, nav), scroll.ts (reveals, parallax), boot.ts (single entry, started by Layout.astro). |
36: | src/styles/         | tokens.css (every design value), glass.css, animations.css, global.css, lab.css (imported only by the lab page).                                                                                    |
37: | src/content/blog/   | Posts. Schema in src/content.config.ts. Read posts only via src/data/blog.ts.                                                                                                                       |
38: 
39: 
40: Section components are one concern each; pages compose them in order. Never build a monolithic page template with inline content — put content in src/data/, structure in components.
41: 
42: ## 3. Content rules
43: 
44: - Frontmatter fields: title, description, pubDate, optional heroImage, tags, draft. Schema in src/content.config.ts.
45: - Listings, RSS (src/pages/rss.xml.ts) and the pager all go through src/data/blog.ts (getBlogPosts(), postUrl()); never call getCollection() directly in a page.
46: - Posts must contain real writing, not lorem ipsum. Placeholders get deleted.
47: - Internal links use trailing slashes (/projects/, /blog/<slug>/).
48: 
49: ## 4. Styling rules
50: 
51: - Every colour/spacing/radius/elevation/z-index/duration/easing is a custom property in src/styles/tokens.css. No new hex values outside tokens.
52: - Surfaces use the glass system: data-glass="…" variants or the GlassPanel / GlassButton components. Do not hand-roll backdrop-filter.
53: - Chips and small elements that would stack blur layers must not use backdrop-filter (see glass.css comments).
54: - Animations: transform/opacity only (compositor-friendly). Anything that hides content before JS runs must be behind the html.js class guard, and must be neutralised under prefers-reduced-motion. Keep the forced-colors fallback working.
55: - Type: three voices only — display (system geometric), body (Atkinson Hyperlegible, self-hosted), mono (system mono). Sizes/steps come from tokens.
56: - TWO THEMES: :root = dark space, \[data-theme='light'\] = Frutiger Aero. Component CSS may branch on html\[data-theme=...\] for visual voice (bubble vs star, halo material) but never for layout or content, and never with hard-coded colours — both voices read tokens. New effects must degrade in both themes and under reduced motion.
57: 
58: ## 5. JavaScript & performance rules
59: 
60: - Client code enters through boot() only. New behaviour = new function in an existing src/scripts/ module (or a new module added to boot.ts), wrapped in the same try/catch style.
61: - All loops: requestAnimationFrame, capped, and paused when offscreen (IntersectionObserver) or hidden (visibilitychange). Provide destroy().
62: - Pointer/cursor effects are gated on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) in CSS and on a pointer-type check in TS; touch devices get a static sky.
63: - Canvas starfield density scales with viewport area; never render more stars on a phone than the engine's mobile budget.
64: - Images: prefer SVG; raster images live in public/ and are referenced root-relative. Social card is public/og-cover.png (source: og-cover.svg).
65: 
66: ## 6. Accessibility rules
67: 
68: - Landmarks on every page: header (nav dock), main#main, footer, labelled navs. One h1 per page. Skip link targets #main.
69: - Active nav item gets aria-current="page"; the mobile toggle manages aria-expanded and closes on Escape/outside click.
70: - Decorative nodes (canvas, glow, icons inside labelled links) are aria-hidden="true". Interactive controls need a visible label or aria-label; sliders pair with <label> elements.
71: - Body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 against glass surfaces; focus states visible (:focus-visible ring in tokens).
72: 
73: ## 7. Verification before finishing any change
74: 
75: ```
76: npm run build          # must pass, no new warnings
77: npx tsc --noEmit       # must be clean
78: npm run check          # build + tsc + wrangler deploy --dry-run
79: ```
80: 
81: Then sanity-grep the output:
82: 
83: ```
84: grep -rIl "example.com\|localhost" dist/client --include="*.html" --include="*.xml"   # must be empty
85: grep -rniI "benjamin\|emond\|cegep\|rtx 4070" src public docs README.md AGENTS.md      # must be empty (no personal info)
86: grep -o "https://bnji.net" dist/client/sitemap-0.xml | head -1                        # canonical origin
87: ```
88: 
89: And for any change touching auth, storage, rate limiting, or the DM/board integrations, grep for credential-shaped strings before committing — this needs no new dependency, just a pattern pass:
90: 
91: ```
92: grep -rniIE "sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{16,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{30,}|xox[baprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]{10,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}|discord(app)?\.com/api/webhooks/[0-9]+/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}" src public docs  # must be empty (no leaked credential shapes)
93: ```
94: 
95: New routes must appear in dist/client/sitemap-0.xml (unless noindex). Headless browsers are unavailable in most sandboxes here: verify structurally (built HTML, jsdom assertions) and rely on the dev server for visual checks.
96: 
97: ## 8. House style
98: 
99: - Tabs for indentation in .astro/.ts/.css; single quotes in TS.
100: - Component files PascalCase.astro; CSS classes kebab-case with a component prefix (.lab-experiment\_\_title); data files kebab-case .ts.
101: - Comments explain why, including the failure a guard prevents. Keep the block comment at the top of each component accurate when you change it.
102: - Do not rewrite unrelated files; keep diffs surgical. Do not delete the starter's useful bones (content collections, RSS, sitemap) — they are product features.

1: # BNJI.NET — configuration guide
2: 
3: Every configurable value in the project, in one place. For each: what it does,
4: whether it is **PUBLIC** (ships to browsers) or **SECRET** (server environment
5: only), where it lives, and how to replace it safely.
6: 
7: > Golden rule: **no real secret ever lands in a file in this repository.**
8: > Secrets live in the deployment environment. Locally, use `.dev.vars`
9: > (git-ignored); in production, `npx wrangler secret put <NAME>`.
10: 
11: ---
12: 
13: ## 1. Site identity & canonical origin — PUBLIC
14: 
15: | Value | Location | Notes |
16: | --- | --- | --- |
17: | `SITE.url` | `src/data/site.ts` | Canonical origin (`https://bnji.net`). `astro.config.mjs` imports it for `site:`, so sitemap/RSS/OG/canonical cannot drift. Never point it at a dev host. |
18: | `SITE.name`, `fullName`, `title`, `description` | `src/data/site.ts` | Wordmark + metadata defaults. |
19: | `SITE.author.*` | `src/data/site.ts` | **Placeholder identity (lorem ipsum).** This project intentionally carries no personal biography; replace only with other placeholders unless the owner decides otherwise. |
20: | `SITE.email`, `SITE.github` | `src/data/site.ts` | Placeholder contact targets; single source for every mailto/profile link. |
21: | Navigation | `src/data/navigation.ts` | `PRIMARY_NAV` (pill nav) and `FUTURE_NAV` (footer "soon" chips). |
22: 
23: ## 2. Theme configuration — PUBLIC
24: 
25: | Value | Location | Notes |
26: | --- | --- | --- |
27: | `THEME_CONFIG.defaultTheme` | `src/config/access.config.ts` | First-paint theme when no preference is stored (`dark` = primary space theme). |
28: | `THEME_CONFIG.storageKey` | same | localStorage key for the visitor's choice. |
29: | Palette / glass / motion tokens | `src/styles/tokens.css` | `:root` = dark theme, `[data-theme='light']` = Frutiger Aero light theme. Re-skin by editing tokens only. |
30: | Aero environment (clouds, bubbles, bokeh) | `src/styles/aero.css`, `src/components/AeroSky.astro` | Bubble field array lives in the component; visuals in CSS. |
31: 
32: ## 3. Background music — PUBLIC source identifiers
33: 
34: | Value | Location | Notes |
35: | --- | --- | --- |
36: | `MUSIC_SOURCE.provider` | `src/config/music.config.ts` | `'none' \| 'youtube' \| 'spotify' \| 'file'`. **Enter your source here.** |
37: | `MUSIC_SOURCE.youtube.videoId` | same | The `?v=` id of a YouTube video. Player loads the IFrame API only after the first user-initiated play. |
38: | `MUSIC_SOURCE.spotify.id` / `.type` | same | Spotify track/album/playlist id. Volume/mute are disabled for this provider (Spotify exposes no volume API). |
39: | `MUSIC_SOURCE.file.url` / `.title` | same | Direct audio URL (same-origin or CORS-enabled). Full transport + loading/error states. |
40: | `MUSIC_SOURCE.defaultVolume` | same | 0..1, applied on first gesture-initiated play. |
41: 
42: Autoplay is impossible by construction: nothing plays or loads before a click.
43: 
44: ## 4. Private direct messages (Discord / desktop notification) — provider PUBLIC, credentials SECRET
45: 
46: | Value | Kind | Location | Notes |
47: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
48: | `DM_INTEGRATION.provider` | PUBLIC | `src/config/integrations.config.ts` | `'none' \| 'discord' \| 'ntfy'`. **Choose here.** |
49: | `DM_INTEGRATION.maxLength`, `cooldownSeconds` | PUBLIC | same | Validation + cooldown policy (server enforces). |
50: | `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | **SECRET** | Worker env | Full Discord webhook URL (contains its token). `npx wrangler secret put DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL`. |
51: | `NTFY_URL` | **SECRET** | Worker env | ntfy.sh or self-hosted topic URL. `npx wrangler secret put NTFY_URL`. |
52: 
53: Read server-side only, via `getSecret()` (`astro:env/server`) in
54: `src/server/env.ts` → used by `src/pages/api/dm.ts`. The form asks
55: `GET /api/dm` whether delivery is enabled and renders an explained disabled
56: state otherwise.

58: ## 5. Public message board — policy PUBLIC, storage credentials SECRET
59: 
60: | Value | Kind | Location | Notes |
61: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
62: | `BOARD_CONFIG.provider` | PUBLIC | `src/config/board.config.ts` | `'memory' \| 'kv' \| 'rest'` preference. |
63: | limits (`maxTextLength`, `maxImageBytes`, `allowedImageTypes`, `postCooldownSeconds`, `pollIntervalMs`, visible-count range) | PUBLIC | same | Abuse/size policy; server re-validates everything. |
64: | `BOARD_KV` binding | **INFRA** | wrangler binding | True persistence. Enable: `npx wrangler kv namespace create board`, then add a binding named `BOARD_KV` in `wrangler.json`. The store auto-detects it — no code change. Until then the board runs on the per-isolate memory provider (documented demo grade). |
65: | `BOARD_REST_URL`, `BOARD_REST_TOKEN` | **SECRET** | Worker env | Optional external JSON API provider. |

67: UI (`src/components/MessageBoard.astro`) ↔ API (`src/pages/api/board.ts`) ↔

70: ## 6. Access control / future auth — rules PUBLIC, credentials SECRET
71: 
72: | Value | Kind | Location | Notes |
73: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
74: | `ACCESS_RULES` | PUBLIC | `src/config/access.config.ts` | Declare protected route prefixes + auth kind. **Empty by default: everything current stays public.** |
75: | `ACCESS_TOKEN` | **SECRET** | Worker env | Bearer token for `auth: 'token'` rules. |
76: | `ACCESS_PASSWORD_SHA` | **SECRET** | Worker env | sha256(hex) of the password for `auth: 'password'` rules. Store the hash, never the password. |
77: | `ACCESS_SECRET` | **SECRET** | Worker env | HMAC key signing the session cookie. |
78: 
79: Honest limitations (also in `src/middleware.ts`): prerendered static pages
80: cannot be protected — a private route must set `export const prerender = false;`
81: so requests run the middleware. Client-side hiding is never used as security.
82: With no secrets configured, rules fail **closed**.
83: 
84: ## 7. Intro sequence — PUBLIC
85: 
86: | Value | Location | Notes |
87: | --- | --- | --- |
88: | `INTRO_CONFIG.enabled` | `src/config/access.config.ts` | Master switch for the homepage scroll intro. |
89: | `INTRO_CONFIG.scrollHeights` | same | Scroll distance in viewport heights. |
90: | `INTRO_CONFIG.sessionKey` | same | sessionStorage flag so skip/completion persists per session. Reduced-motion visitors never enter it. |
91: 
92: ## 8. Blog & content — PUBLIC
93: 
94: | Value | Location | Notes |
95: | --- | --- | --- |
96: | Posts | `src/content/blog/*.md` | Drop-in workflow; schema in `src/content.config.ts` (markdown only — MDX was removed with its workflow). |
97: | Post helpers | `src/data/blog.ts` | The only read path for collections. |
98: | Lab experiments | `src/data/lab.ts` + `src/components/lab/*` + the static map in `src/pages/lab.astro` | Add a game = component + data entry + one map line. |
99: 
100: ## 9. Deployment — INFRA (do not change casually)
101: 
102: | Value | Location | Notes |
103: | --- | --- | --- |
104: | Worker name/compat/assets | `wrangler.json` | Static assets from `./dist`. |
105: | Adapter options | `astro.config.mjs` | `prerenderEnvironment: "node"`. |
106: | Env schema (secrets list) | `astro.config.mjs` (`env.schema`) | Declares which secrets exist; all optional so builds work unconfigured. |
107: 
108: ## 10. Replacing things safely — checklist
109: 
110: 1. Public value → edit the single config file above; grep for duplicates.
111: 2. Secret → set it in the environment (`wrangler secret put` / `.dev.vars`);
112:    add it to `env.schema` in `astro.config.mjs` and to `secretEnv()` in
113:    `src/server/env.ts`; document it here.
114: 3. Storage provider → change `BOARD_CONFIG.provider` and/or add the binding;
115:    UI stays untouched.
116: 4. After any change: `npm run build && npx tsc --noEmit`, then grep `dist/`
117:    for the secret's *name* (should appear only in server bundles, never in
118:    `dist/client/**`).
